sources.title: NC State vs. Stanford injury report: Duke Scott among many players out
sources.description: Has NC State’s injury situation improved after a week off? No, not really. In addition to missing at least two starting linemen, State will again be without running back Duke Scott, so that’s unfortunate. Not as unfortunate as the Pack’s dilapidated ground game, but not far off. Yousef Mugharbil joined the out-for-season list after the […]
